grader.scenario: Mobile data speed throttled to 2G speeds despite having 15GB remaining allowance; 6 faults (poor)
grader.notes: Poor call marked by failed branding, dead air, failed verification, failed personalization, rude remarks, and unresolved throttling, alongside handled empathy.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent failed opening branding ('Cellular technical queue, agent 401.') and closing branding.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent allowed two separate unmanaged dead air gaps of 35 seconds at turns 14 and 34.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent failed to ask for address or security PIN during verification.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent never addressed customer as Oscar anywhere in the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I understand how terrifying and freezing cold that situation is in your lorry cab near Inverness...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the data throttling issue in own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for mobile number at turn 42 despite customer stating 07700 900741 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent refused to override throttle or offer immediate assistance.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at turn 11: 'If you use your mobile handset as a substitute home broadband pipe for video streaming, you trigger automated traffic management throttling.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent gathered details on data allowance and speed test outcomes.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
